defects_addressed.detail: The scenario schedules the inbound transit to start at 20:12 EDT, but Standing Order 12 restricts transit commencement to the window 17:58-20:28 EDT. The transit from sea buoy to berth takes 3h05m, so the vessel would not complete transit within the window. The scenario should reflect that the transit cannot commence after 20:28, leading to a delay until the next window on 2026-08-14, resulting in a NO answer.
